description: Result-file and injection probes for the container tier: a test script that writes a JUnit file whose test names and output carry shell, Markdown, mention, and workflow-expression text, a committed symlink to a system file, a result path that is a directory, a small binary result file, and a 2796203-byte 0xFF result file generated at run time; one declared result file is never written.

entries.content: echo '$(touch /tmp/pwned) `id` ; rm -rf / && echo owned' echo '**bold** [link](https://example.invalid) ' echo '@octocat #1 owner/repo#2' echo '${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}' mkdir -p reports printf '%s' '' > reports/injection.xml mkdir -p reports/dir.xml printf 'a\000b\377c' > reports/binary.xml head -c 2796203 /dev/zero | tr '\000' '\377' > reports/ff.xml exit 0
